title: An Argo CD API answers unauthenticated
summary: The Argo CD API returns its version without a sign in, which usually means the GitOps controller is exposed.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and body_contains("BuildDate") and body_contains("GitCommit") and body_contains("Version") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Require authentication on Argo CD and keep it off the public internet.
